content.title: Hudson Williams Brought His Girlfriend to the VF After-Party
content.text: Things you buy through our links may earn Vox Media a commission Photo: Neilson Barnard/Getty Images On Sunday, a month after their Valentine’s Day hard launch, Hudson Williams and his girlfriend celebrated another major milestone: their red-carpet debut. The longtime couple stepped out together at an Oscars after-party hosted by Vanity Fair. The magazine identified Williams’s girlfriend, whom he’s previously spoken about but didn’t name, as Katelyn Rose Larson, a tattoo artist. Williams and Larson posed together at the event in coordinating sheer black looks. Williams wore a very nipple-forward high-neck blouse by Balenciaga with black trousers, while Larson wore a black lace cutout gown by Bronx and Banco with green statement earrings. Of course, Connor Storrie was there too … also in a coordinated look. Storrie wore a sheer turtleneck to the party, but, according to Williams’s stylist, Anastasia Walker, that was just a coincidence. “Me and [Storrie’s stylist James Yardley] did not plan this lol,” Walker wrote in a post on her Instagram Story.
